title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: overflow actions for direct inward dialed calls
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, optional setup and publish-time credit consumption are supported, including by the updated billing page. Microsoft does not establish that voicemail is the only unconfigured fallback; the control paths and API note also need small clarifications.

claims.claim: The feature provides overflow actions for direct inward calls in Dynamics 365 Contact Center.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls

claims.claim: The printed Copilot Service admin center path reaches the Handle overflow for direct inbound call template.
claims.quote:
In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, in Customer support, select Conversation Orchestration.

claims.fix: Extend both printed paths to 'Customer support > Conversation Orchestration > Prompt gallery > Overflow handling > Handle overflow for direct inbound call > Build playbook > overflow action'. Retain the note to choose and save the inbound-profile scope first.

claims.claim: Learn says an unanswered direct call usually goes to voicemail by default when the representative is busy or away.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go requires an Azure subscription.

claims.claim: The in-queue playbook exemption requires only one branch.

claims.claim: The direct-call setup procedure finishes by saving and publishing the playbook.

claims.where: Governance controls: API explanation; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited table reference does not document an operation that executes playbook publication.
claims.quote: Searched: CC User Prompt publish API; read its Messages and searched its full reference for publish. The writable Prompt Stage has a Published value, but no operation is documented as executing conversion, validation and publication; Configure conversation orchestration gives UI publication.

claims.claim: The CC User Prompt reference does not document the format of inbound-profile scope lists.
claims.quote: Searched the full CC User Prompt reference for scope and prompt; read msdyn_inclusionlist and msdyn_exclusionlist. They are writable Memo/Text fields with empty descriptions, not documented inbound-profile list formats.

claims.claim: Learn describes no separate tenant-wide switch specifically for the direct-call overflow scenario.
claims.quote: Searched: conversation orchestration direct inward call tenant switch; conversation orchestration enable disable direct inbound. Read Manage overflow, orchestration setup and Responsible AI FAQ. A shared orchestration toggle is documented, but no separate direct-call scenario toggle.

claims.claim: Billing and capacity administration, rather than the playbook editor, provides the documented spend-management mechanisms.
claims.quote:
For prepaid capacity, use the Power Platform admin center to allocate more of the tenant's available capacity to the environment.
For pay-as-you-go, use Microsoft Cost Management in the Azure portal to view detailed usage and adjust spending limits (budgets)

claims.claim: Every monitoring control the checklist tells the reader to use is represented in the controls table.

claims.fix: The 'Run the overflow custom query' checklist step has no controls-table row. Remove that checklist bullet; retain the supported diagnostics explanation in Risk assessment. Do not add a control row.
